summary:
The visible suite now passes (3 tests). The failures came from two bugs, and I changed one file for each.

- **`solution/util.py`:** the token regex listed the single-character operators before `**`. `**` was therefore tokenized as two `*` tokens, which caused the "unexpected token '*'" errors. I moved `\*\*` to the front of the alternation.
- **`solution/core.py`:** the right-hand side of `**` was parsed with `self.atom()`. It now uses `self.unary()`, which matches the grammar comment ("rhs allows unary minus") and makes `**` right-associative.
